info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Collateral Management API
info.description: The Collateral Management API facilitates the retrieval of collateral information associated with specific loan applications. It allows users to query details for a particular collateral item given the loan application ID and collateral ID. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions and loan officers needing to assess the collateral backing a loan. By providing concise and relevant collateral data, it enhances decision-making in lending processes.

get.summary: Retrieve collateral details for a specified loan application.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the collateral information associated with a loan application identified by its unique ID. It serves as a crucial step in managing loan records and assessing financial risk.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving collateral details related to a specific loan application. This body is expected to be in JSON format and is used to specify details necessary for the GET operation.

GetLoanApplicationCollateralsForRes10004.description: This schema represents the JSON body format for GET operations regarding loan applications and collaterals.

GetLoanApplicationCollateralsForRes10004.title: Collateral

collateralType.description: The type of collateral (e.g. real estate, vehicle).

ownershipType.description: The ownership status of the collateral (e.g. owned, leased).

ownerCustomerIds.description: List of customer IDs who own the collateral.

items.description: A unique identifier for a customer owning the collateral.

description.description: A brief description of the collateral.

marketValue.description: The current market value of the collateral.

forcedSaleValue.description: The estimated value of the collateral in a forced sale scenario.

valuationDate.description: The date when the collateral was last valued.

valuationProvider.description: The entity that provided the valuation of the collateral.

lienPriority.description: The priority of the lien on the collateral (e.g. first priority, second priority).

id.description: A unique identifier for the collateral item.

status.description: The current status of the collateral (e.g. active, inactive).

loanToValuePercent.description: The loan-to-value ratio expressed as a percentage.

perfectedAt.description: The date when the lien was perfected.

audit.description: Audit information related to the collateral.

metadata.description: Additional metadata associated with the collateral.

GetLoanApplicationCollateralsForRes10004.description: A representation of a loan collateral item, including its type, ownership details, values, and related metadata.

Value.title: Value
Value.description: A monetary value representation with currency.

Audit.title: Audit Information

createdAt.description: The date and time when the collateral was created.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the collateral.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the collateral was last updated.

updatedBy.description: The identifier of the user who last updated the collateral.

version.description: The version number of the collateral record.

Audit.description: Metadata related to the creation and modification of the collateral.

Metadata.title: Metadata

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response that includes this collateral data.

correlationId.description: An identifier used for tracing the request and response flow.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the collateral was processed.

Metadata.description: Additional metadata associated with the loan collateral.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses Bearer Authentication, which requires the client to send a JSON Web Token (JWT) as part of the HTTP Authorization header. The JWT should be obtained through a login process.
